cards.title: PILFERED POWER
cards.meta: Alder • Level 3 Shadowmancer Ability • Patron Power
cards.rules: Steal power from your Patron to cast tiered spells at the highest tier unlocked. You may do this DEX times before your Patron notices. Each excess use costs half your maximum HP. The limit resets when you commune during a Safe Rest.

cards.title: MASTER OF NIGHTFROST
cards.meta: Alder • Level 3 Abyssal Depths Ability • Passive
cards.rules: Learn Ice spells and breathe underwater. Shadow Blast and nightfrost minions may deal cold or necrotic damage. Whenever they would critically hit, gain INT + level temporary HP.

cards.title: MASTER OF DARKNESS
cards.meta: Alder • Level 3 Shadowmancer Ability • Spell Knowledge
cards.rules: Your Patron grants you knowledge of Necrotic cantrips and tier 1 Necrotic spells.

cards.title: MY FAVORED PET
cards.meta: Alder • Lesser Shadow Invocation • Utility
cards.rules: One shadow minion can begrudgingly tolerate you outside combat. It can, very creepily, perform any menial task a below-average commoner could.

cards.title: DANGER POLLEN / SPORES
cards.meta: Alder • Shroomling Ancestry Ability • When Wounded
cards.rules: Whenever an enemy causes you 1 or more Wounds, excrete soporific spores: all adjacent enemies are Dazed. You know Elvish if your INT is not negative.

cards.title: WILD ONE
cards.meta: Alder • Background Ability • Wilderness
cards.rules: Wild creatures are less frightened of you and more willing to aid you. Gain +1 Nature Craft. During a Field Rest in the wild, roll your Hit Dice with advantage.

cards.title: MERCIFUL HEALING
cards.meta: Cai Lin • Level 3 Luminary of Mercy Ability • Dying Creatures
cards.rules: When an effect you cause heals a Dying creature, it heals twice as much. Once per round while you are Dying, your Lifebinding Spirit may act for free.

cards.title: SEARING LIGHT
cards.meta: Cai Lin • Level 3 Shepherd Ability • WIL (2)/Safe Rest • 1 Action • Reach 6
cards.rules: Choose one: heal 2d8 HP to a Dying creature; or deal 2d8 radiant damage to an undead or Bloodied enemy.

cards.title: LIFE IS BEAUTIFUL
cards.meta: Cai Lin • Level 3 Luminary of Mercy Ability • Passive
cards.rules: Harmless, lovely creatures such as butterflies and hummingbirds are attracted to you and often follow you. Flowers bloom more vibrantly in your presence.

cards.title: TRADESMAN / ARTISAN: HEALER & HERBALIST
cards.meta: Cai Lin • Background Ability • Healing and Herbalism
cards.rules: Gain advantage on checks related to healing and herbalism, and retain special knowledge about that profession.

cards.title: RELENTLESS
cards.meta: Cai Lin • Orc Ancestry Ability • 1/Safe Rest
cards.rules: When you would drop to 0 HP, set your HP to your level (3) instead. Gain +1 Might. You know Goblin, which you call Orcish, if your INT is not negative.

cards.title: HUNTER'S MARK
cards.meta: Da Long • Level 3 Hunter Ability • 1 Action • Lasts 1 Day
cards.rules: Mark a creature you can see as your quarry for 1 day, or until you mark another creature. It cannot be hidden from you. Before each attack against it, choose advantage or +3 damage.

cards.title: THRILL OF THE HUNT
cards.meta: Da Long • Level 3 Hunter Ability • Gain Thrill
cards.rules: Gain 1 Thrill charge when your quarry dies, you hit it in melee, or you critically hit it at range. Abilities that spend Thrill cannot generate it. Unspent charges are lost when combat ends.

cards.title: GO FOR THE THROAT!
cards.meta: Da Long • Level 3 Beastmaster • 1/Encounter • 2 Thrill + 2 Actions
cards.rules: Quickfeather attacks your quarry for 1d12 + 12 damage, ignoring Armor. If it dies, deal half as much damage to another creature within Reach 4.

cards.title: ROLL & STRIKE
cards.meta: Da Long • Level 3 Hunter Ability • 1 Action • Requires 0 Thrill
cards.rules: If you have no Thrill charges, move up to your Speed toward your quarry. If you end adjacent, make a melee attack against it for free.

cards.title: ALPHA PROTECTOR
cards.meta: Da Long • Level 3 Beastmaster Feature • Large Companion
cards.rules: Damage from the first attack against you each round is halved.

cards.title: FORAGER
cards.meta: Da Long • Level 3 Hunter Ability • Wilderness
cards.rules: Gain advantage on skill checks to find food and water in the wild.

cards.title: TRACKER'S INTUITION
cards.meta: Da Long • Level 3 Hunter Ability • Investigation
cards.rules: Study tracks and subtle environmental clues to discern a past encounter: the kind and number of creatures, their direction, key actions, and the passage of time.

cards.title: BEASTMASTER - QUICKFEATHER
cards.meta: Da Long • Level 3 Beastmaster Feature • Large Companion
cards.rules: Quickfeather's HP and movement are abstracted. At GM discretion it may fly, carry riders, track scents, Grapple, or Help. Spend 1 action to command a complex task. Its attacks count as yours for gaining Thrill.

cards.title: PROTECT ME!
cards.meta: Da Long • Level 3 Beastmaster Ability • After a Wound • 1/Encounter
cards.rules: After you gain a Wound, Quickfeather may whisk you up to 12 spaces away to safety.

cards.title: RELENTLESS
cards.meta: Da Long • Orc Ancestry Ability • 1/Safe Rest
cards.rules: When you would drop to 0 HP, set your HP to your level (3) instead. Gain +1 Might. You know Goblin, which you call Orcish, if your INT is not negative.

cards.title: SURVIVALIST
cards.meta: Da Long • Background Ability • Survival
cards.rules: You never run out of personal rations. Anything can be food. Gain advantage on poison saves and +1 maximum Hit Die.

cards.title: COORDINATED STRIKE!
cards.meta: Feng Rui • Level 3 Commander Order • 1/Round • INT (2)/Safe Rest • Free Action
cards.rules: You and one ally within 6 spaces each immediately make a weapon attack or cast a cantrip for free.

cards.title: REPOSITION!
cards.meta: Feng Rui • Level 3 Commander Order • Action or Reaction on Ally's Turn
cards.rules: Command one ally to move up to their Speed for free, or two allies to each move up to half their Speed for free.

cards.title: SHIELD EXPERT
cards.meta: Feng Rui • Level 3 Champion of the Bulwark Ability • 1/Round
cards.rules: Reduce damage from an attack by your shield's Armor value without Defending. When you do, deal that much damage to an enemy within Reach.

cards.title: HOLD THE LINE!
cards.meta: Feng Rui • Level 3 Commander Order • Reaction at Ally 0 HP • 1/Encounter
cards.rules: Command that ally to continue the fight. Set their HP to 3 × your level (9).

cards.title: FIELD MEDIC
cards.meta: Feng Rui • Level 3 Commander Ability • Healing
cards.rules: Roll 1 additional die for any health potion you administer. After you spend at least 10 minutes examining a creature's wounds, they add your Examination bonus to HP recovered from Hit Dice.

cards.title: ARMOR MASTER
cards.meta: Feng Rui • Level 3 Champion of the Bulwark Ability • Passive
cards.rules: You are proficient with plate armor.

cards.title: DEVOTED PROTECTOR - CAI LIN
cards.meta: Feng Rui • Background Ability • While Cai Lin Is Nearby
cards.rules: You can survive +3 maximum Wounds while Cai Lin is nearby. Whenever Cai Lin takes a Wound, you do too.

cards.title: RELENTLESS
cards.meta: Feng Rui • Orc Ancestry Ability • 1/Safe Rest
cards.rules: When you would drop to 0 HP, set your HP to your level (3) instead. Gain +1 Might. You know Goblin, which you call Orcish, if your INT is not negative.

cards.title: RAGE
cards.meta: Jian Bo • Level 3 Berserker Ability • 1 Action • 1/Turn
cards.rules: Roll a Fury Die (1d4) and set it aside. Add it to every STR attack you make. You can have a maximum of KEY (2) Fury Dice; they are lost when your Rage ends.

cards.title: INTENSIFYING FURY
cards.meta: Jian Bo • Level 3 Berserker Ability • Start of Turn While Raging
cards.rules: If you are Raging at the beginning of your turn, roll 1 Fury Die for free.

cards.title: BLOODLUST
cards.meta: Jian Bo • Level 3 Berserker Ability • On Your Turn • Spend Fury
cards.rules: Expend 1 or more Fury Dice on your turn. Move DEX (2) spaces per die spent for free.

cards.title: THAT ALL YOU GOT?!
cards.meta: Jian Bo • Level 3 Berserker Reaction • When Attacked • Spend Fury
cards.rules: When you are attacked, you may expend 1 or more Fury Dice to reduce the damage taken by STR + DEX (4) for each die spent.

cards.title: MOUNTAINOUS TENACITY
cards.meta: Jian Bo • Level 3 Mountainheart Ability • Spend Hit Dice
cards.rules: Whenever you expend Hit Dice to recover HP, for every 10 HP you would recover, you may heal 1 Wound instead.

cards.title: ONE WITH THE ANCIENTS
cards.meta: Jian Bo • Level 3 Berserker Ability • 1/Safe Rest
cards.rules: When faced with a decision about which direction or course of action to take, call upon your ancestors to guide you toward the most dangerous or challenging path.

cards.title: STONE'S RESILIENCE
cards.meta: Jian Bo • Level 3 Mountainheart Ability • Spend Fury to Reduce Damage
cards.rules: Whenever you expend Fury Dice to reduce incoming damage, add the value of each spent die to the amount reduced.

cards.title: RELENTLESS
cards.meta: Jian Bo • Orc Ancestry Ability • 1/Safe Rest
cards.rules: When you would drop to 0 HP, set your HP to your level (3) instead. Gain +1 Might. You know Goblin, which you call Orcish, if your INT is not negative.

cards.title: FEARLESS
cards.meta: Jian Bo • Background Ability • Passive
cards.rules: You are immune to the Frightened condition. Gain +1 Initiative and -1 Armor.

cards.title: IRON DEFENSE
cards.meta: Lil Chang • Level 3 Zephyr Ability • While Unarmored
cards.rules: Your Armor equals DEX + STR as long as you are unarmored.

cards.title: SWIFT FISTS
cards.meta: Lil Chang • Level 3 Zephyr Ability • Unarmed Strikes
cards.rules: Your unarmed strikes are not subject to disadvantage imposed by Rushed Attacks, and their damage is 1d4 + STR.

cards.title: BURST OF SPEED
cards.meta: Lil Chang • Level 3 Zephyr Ability • At Initiative • 1/Turn
cards.rules: At Initiative, gain DEX Bursts for this encounter. Spend 1 for a free maneuver: Slipstream - Defend and the attack misses; Whirling Defense - Defend and apply Armor to every attack this round; Swiftstrike - attack without Rushed disadvantage; Windstep - Move ignoring difficult terrain.

cards.title: KINETIC MOMENTUM
cards.meta: Lil Chang • Level 3 Zephyr Ability • When Wounded
cards.rules: Whenever you gain a Wound, gain 1 Burst of Speed.

cards.title: BRING THE PAIN
cards.meta: Lil Chang • Level 3 Way of Pain Ability • When Attacked
cards.rules: You may turn any melee attack against you into a critical hit. Whenever you are critically hit, halve the damage and deal the amount you took back to the attacker, ignoring Armor. You may suffer 1 Wound to double the reflected damage.

cards.title: SWIFT FEET
cards.meta: Lil Chang • Level 3 Zephyr Ability • While Unarmored
cards.rules: While unarmored, gain +2 Speed and +level Initiative.

cards.title: ETHEREAL PROJECTION
cards.meta: Lil Chang • Level 3 Zephyr Ability • 1/Day • 10-Minute Meditation
cards.rules: Project a visible, translucent version of yourself up to 30 feet away for up to 10 minutes. It passes through barriers and you see through its eyes, but it cannot interact physically with the environment.

cards.title: RELENTLESS
cards.meta: Lil Chang • Orc Ancestry Ability • 1/Safe Rest
cards.rules: When you would drop to 0 HP, set your HP to your level (3) instead. Gain +1 Might. You know Goblin, which you call Orcish, if your INT is not negative.

cards.title: FEARLESS
cards.meta: Lil Chang • Background Ability • Passive
cards.rules: You are immune to the Frightened condition. Gain +1 Initiative and -1 Armor.

cards.title: SONGWEAVER'S INSPIRATION
cards.meta: Mei Rong • Level 3 Songweaver Ability • 4/Safe Rest • Free Reaction
cards.rules: Allow an ally to reroll one die related to an attack or save; they may keep either result.

cards.title: QUICK WIT
cards.meta: Mei Rong • Level 3 Songweaver Ability • When Rolling Initiative
cards.rules: Regain 2 spent uses of Songweaver's Inspiration. Unused regained uses expire at the end of combat.

cards.title: INSPIRING PRESENCE
cards.meta: Mei Rong • Level 3 Herald of Courage Ability • When Inspiring
cards.rules: Whenever you use Songweaver's Inspiration, allies within 12 spaces who can hear you gain WIL (2) temporary HP.

cards.title: JACK OF ALL TRADES
cards.meta: Mei Rong • Level 3 Songweaver Ability • Safe Rest
cards.rules: When you Safe Rest, you may move 1 skill point as if you had just leveled up.

cards.title: SONG OF REST
cards.meta: Mei Rong • Level 3 Songweaver Ability • 1/Day • Field Rest
cards.rules: Play a song during a Field Rest. Anyone who spends Hit Dice heals additional HP equal to your WIL (2).

cards.title: HISTORY BUFF
cards.meta: Mei Rong • Background Ability • Lore
cards.rules: Gain advantage on Lore checks about items, facts, or events that happened more than 100 years ago.

cards.title: RELENTLESS
cards.meta: Mei Rong • Orc Ancestry Ability • 1/Safe Rest
cards.rules: When you would drop to 0 HP, set your HP to your level (3) instead. Gain +1 Might. You know Goblin, which you call Orcish, if your INT is not negative.
